Resolves #20359

🌿 A grid column can no longer show a nested value in a plain cell and lose it in a progress bar.

`Neo.grid.column.Base#getRecordValue(record, field=this.dataField)` reads a field the way a plain cell does. A record resolves a dotted path through `Record#get`, and a Turbo Mode row (`autoInitRecords: false`) is a plain object, which resolves it through `Neo.ns`. The eight column types that read `record[...]` themselves now go through it: Progress, Sparkline, Tree, Icon, IconLink, LinkedIn, CountryFlag and AnimatedCurrency (with its `compareField || dataField` choice). `AnimatedChange#onRecordChange` now also matches a change under the path's root field (`metrics` for `metrics.load`) and animates only when the value at the path moved.

Evidence: L2 (unit arms over a real store record and a plain row object, red-first on dev) → L2 required (AC-1, AC-2; AC-3 is the existing tiers in CI). Residual: none.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; the baseline jobs run in CI.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/grid/column/NestedDataField.spec.mjs`. Each of the nine types reads a nested and a flat `dataField`, on a store record and on a plain row object, and gets the same value. |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: the same spec's `AnimatedChange` arms: a nested change animates, and a change to a sibling member of the same object stays still. |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: the existing grid unit and e2e tiers. Local run of `test/playwright/unit/grid`: 405 passed. |

## Deltas from ticket
- **Two sibling reads go through the same reader:** `CountryFlag`'s `contentField` and `IconLink`'s `labelField` had the same `record[...]` read, so a nested label or location now works too.
- **`getRecordValue` returns `undefined` for a missing record** instead of handing `Neo.ns` an empty scope. Without that guard, `Neo.ns` would fall back to resolving the path on `globalThis`.

## Test Evidence
Red-first: with only the source change backed out, the new spec fails exactly its 10 nested arms (eight type reads, the nested `compareField`, the nested `AnimatedChange` change), and its 10 flat and stay-still controls pass. With the change, it passes 20 of 20.

## Post-Merge Validation
None: every AC is covered by the unit tier.
